'''Khel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed in the [[Dorn Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he acted as a warden for the captured prisoner [[Blizz]]. His prisoner slipped out of his cell several times, but never tried to escape, instead choosing to taking apart the machinery. After Blizz aided a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] in tracking down [[Reneget Vause]], the hunter persuaded Aristocra [[Shah'adrom'illithyr]] into letting Blizz go and join his crew.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Warden Khel appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on Hoth.
